subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should crawl-remote production deployment be owned by this protected ClawSweeper workflow using Vincent Koc's immutable actor gate, ancestor-of-main release authorization, and the documented Cloudflare environment boundary?
rationale: Source review can validate the workflow's fail-closed checks, but only repository owners can authorize the production operator, cross-repository trust window, external environment controls, backup access, and cutover policy.

options.title: Approve controlled rollout
options.body: Retain the current defense-in-depth design after independently verifying the environment reviewers, branch restriction, least-privilege token, production identities, dormant migration compatibility, and recovery procedure.

options.title: Narrow authorization first
options.body: Require current-main-tip releases or a documented team-based dispatcher policy if ancestor rollback or single-operator access is broader than owners intend.

options.title: Keep deployment external
options.body: Do not merge if crawl-remote or a separate operations repository should retain production credentials and deployment ownership.

recommendation.title: Approve controlled rollout
recommendation.body: Retain the current defense-in-depth design after independently verifying the environment reviewers, branch restriction, least-privilege token, production identities, dormant migration compatibility, and recovery procedure.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history identifies him as the strongest owner of repository workflow and release policy, while Vincent Koc is the proposed operator and implementation owner whose input is also essential.
